name: com.modelsalt/model-salt
title: Model Salt
description: Randomness from outside the model, so one prompt gives different answers that still fit the ask.

tools.name: model_salt
tools.description: Settles a creative request's open choices with physical randomness, without seeing the request. Before calling, write in your reply 5 decisions with 5 numbered options each (option 1 the usual choice). Send only the option count of each decision, e.g. [5, 5, 5, 5, 5]. Returns one option number per decision: use exactly those options, write each one out, then make the result.

counts.description: How many options each decision has, in order. Nothing else from the chat.

randomness.description: Optional: only if the user asked for more or less variety, 0 the usual answer to 2 as varied as it gets.
